children: Intellia announced FDA acceptance of the BLA for lonvo-z and Priority Review with a PDUFA action date of March 10, 2027.
FDA accepted the Biologics License Application for lonvo-z and granted Priority Review.
PDUFA target action date set for March 10, 2027, guiding regulatory timing expectations.
FDA does not currently plan to hold an advisory committee on the application.
If approved, lonvo-z would be the world’s first in vivo CRISPR-based therapy and a one-time HAE treatment.
BLA supported by Phase 3 HAELO data showing 87% reduction in mean monthly attacks and 62% attack-free rate.
